description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultLoanLifecycleStateMachine class within the loan account domain of Apache Fineract. It tests various state transition scenarios of loan objects, verifying correct status changes and event notifications.

classes.name: DefaultLoanLifecycleStateMachineTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of DefaultLoanLifecycleStateMachine's state transitions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and static methods before each test.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Cleans up mocks and resets context after each test.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanCreation
methods.description: Verifies that a loan transitions to SUBMITTED_AND_PENDING_APPROVAL when created.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanRejection
methods.description: Verifies transition to REJECTED upon loan rejection.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanApproval
methods.description: Verifies transition to APPROVED upon loan approval.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanWithdraw
methods.description: Verifies transition to WITHDRAWN_BY_CLIENT.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanDisbursementWhenLoanIsApproved
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE after disbursing an approved loan.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanDisbursementWhenLoanIsClosedObligationsMet
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE after disbursing a closed obligations loan.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanDisbursementWhenLoanIsOverpaid
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE when an overpaid loan is disbursed, considering total overpaid amount.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanDisbursementWhenLoanIsOverpaidAndGotClosed
methods.description: Verifies transition to CLOSED_OBLIGATIONS_MET when overpaid loan's outstanding is zero at disbursement.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanDisbursementWhenLoanIsOverpaidAndRemainsOverpaid
methods.description: Ensures no status change when overpaid loan remains overpaid after disbursement.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanApprovalUndo
methods.description: Verifies transition back to SUBMITTED_AND_PENDING_APPROVAL when approval is undone.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanDisbursementUndo
methods.description: Verifies transition back to APPROVED when disbursement is undone.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanChargePaymentWhenClosedObligationsMet
methods.description: Verifies that status transitions to ACTIVE after a charge payment when obligations are met.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanChargePaymentWhenOverpaid
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE after a charge payment when the loan is overpaid.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanRepaidInFullWhenActive
methods.description: Verifies transition to CLOSED_OBLIGATIONS_MET when a loan in ACTIVE status is repaid in full.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanRepaidInFullWhenOverpaid
methods.description: Verifies transition to CLOSED_OBLIGATIONS_MET when an overpaid loan is fully repaid.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanWriteOffOutstanding
methods.description: Verifies transition to CLOSED_WRITTEN_OFF after write-off.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanRescheduled
methods.description: Verifies transition to CLOSED_RESCHEDULE_OUTSTANDING_AMOUNT after rescheduling.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanOverpaymentWhenActive
methods.description: Verifies status change to OVERPAID when overpayment occurs with an active loan.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanOverpaymentWhenClosedObligationsMet
methods.description: Verifies status change to OVERPAID when overpayment occurs with obligations met.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanAdjustTransactionWhenClosedObligationsMet
methods.description: Checks transition to ACTIVE after adjustment during closed obligations met status.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanAdjustTransactionWhenClosedWrittenOff
methods.description: Checks transition to ACTIVE after adjustment during written off status.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanAdjustTransactionWhenClosedRescheduleOutstandingAmount
methods.description: Checks transition to ACTIVE during rescheduled outstanding amount.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanInitiateTransfer
methods.description: Verifies transition to TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS on initiate transfer.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanRejectTransfer
methods.description: Verifies transition to TRANSFER_ON_HOLD on reject transfer.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanWithdrawTransfer
methods.description: Verifies transition back to ACTIVE when transfer is withdrawn.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanWriteOffOutstandingUndo
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE after undoing write-off.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanCreditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Verifies transition to CLOSED_OBLIGATIONS_MET after credit balance refund.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanChargeAdded
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE when a charge is added while obligations are met.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanChargebackWhenClosedObligationsMet
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE on chargeback with obligations met.

methods.name: testTransitionShouldWorkProperlyForLoanChargebackWhenOverpaid
methods.description: Verifies transition to ACTIVE on chargeback when loan is overpaid.
